summary: Verified P0 bug fixes on /payouts page + regression on /transactions. Both bugs are fixed: (1) Recent settlements rows now render amount+ticker exactly once (e.g. '0.01536406 ETH', '111.86 USDT-TRC20') with NO duplicated ticker like 'ETH 0.01536406 · ETH'. (2) NO synthetic internal identifiers appear anywhere on the page — none of the banned substrings ('@dynopay.internal', '@dynopay.local', 'legacy-api-', 'pk-buyer-', 'elements-buyer-', 'recovered-') were found. API-sourced rows now show a clean payer label 'Legacy API Customer · <date>' and non-API rows show 'Direct payment · <date>'. Pending funds card shows the empty state 'No payments awaiting confirmation right now.'. Auto-convert protection card renders with '$0.00 THIS MONTH'. Weekly payout digest card renders with toggle; toggling ON reveals the 'Send preview' button (data-testid payouts-digest-preview-btn) as expected, toggling OFF hides it (we did NOT click preview). No console errors. No horizontal overflow at 1920x800 (scrollWidth == clientWidth == 1920). Transactions regression: /transactions renders, the 'Settled only' checkbox (data-testid transactions-export-settled-only) is present next to Export, and the USD Value column shows real values (e.g. $48.46, $37.63, $111.86).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Could not detect the sonner/toast text via generic selectors after toggling the digest switch — behavior still works (preview button appears/disappears), but if a toast is expected to be shown, verify the toast container has a queryable role or data-testid. This is non-blocking.

Minor: The digest Switch component does not expose aria-checked attribute (returned None before/after toggle). Consider ensuring the underlying Radix Switch has aria-checked reflected for accessibility/testing. Functional toggle works via visible preview-button appearance.

rca of the issue: Original bug: Payouts rows built the string as `${ticker} ${amount} · ${ticker}` and used raw `customer_email` (synthetic emails like legacy-api-1-...@dynopay.internal for API-sourced rows). Fix (verified): payerLabel() now maps API/store/tip/donation/etc sources to clean labels (e.g. 'Legacy API Customer', 'Direct payment') and filters out any string matching the internal patterns; amountLabel() renders `${amount} ${ticker}` a single time. Verified visually and via full-page text scan for banned substrings + duplicated-ticker regex — both returned zero matches.
